recognize_zh: 合成圖 A 格（100x 抹片）為大型母細胞，胞質深藍且布滿清楚空泡，核染色質細緻，外觀很像 Burkitt 淋巴瘤細胞；B–D 為 FISH、E 為核型，須靠 BCR::ABL1 證據與骨髓性標記才能判定為 CML 骨髓性急變期。
features: Panel A: large blasts with round to oval nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and moderate to abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Prominent, sharply punched-out cytoplasmic vacuoles creating a Burkitt-like appearance
Occasional maturing granulocytes in the background; no Auer rods evident at this resolution
Panels B-D: interphase and metaphase FISH with red/green signals and arrows marking fusion or abnormal signals (labels not legible at this resolution)
Panel E: karyotype ideogram with additional abnormalities (details not legible)
describe_en: Composite figure. The smear in panel A shows large blasts with fine chromatin, moderate to abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm and numerous distinct cytoplasmic vacuoles, closely mimicking Burkitt lymphoma/leukemia cells; a maturing granulocyte is present nearby. Panels B-D display interphase and metaphase FISH images with abnormal signal patterns, and panel E shows a karyotype; probe names and specific abnormalities are not legible at this resolution. In a patient with CML, vacuolated blasts must be immunophenotyped, as the morphology alone cannot establish lineage; findings are consistent with myeloid blast phase of CML with lymphoma-like morphology when myeloid markers and BCR::ABL1 are demonstrated.

ddx.vs: Burkitt cells are mature B cells (CD19/CD20/CD10/sIg+, TdT-negative) with MYC rearrangement and no BCR::ABL1 fusion.
Lymphoid blasts are TdT/CD19/CD10-positive and MPO-negative, whereas myeloid blast phase shows MPO, CD13/CD33/CD117 expression.

ddx.dx: Acute monocytic leukemia with vacuolated blasts
ddx.vs: Monoblasts are nonspecific esterase- and CD14/CD64-positive with folded nuclei and lack the Philadelphia chromosome.
